metadata.title: आदिम जनजातियों को बचाने का राष्ट्रीय मिशन | National Mission to Save Primitive tribes
metadata.description: Today Union Budget for 2023-24 presented in the parliament. The finance minister announced RS 15000 crore for national mission for vulnerable tribes. India has 75 tribes which are categorised as particularly vulnerable tribal groups. Many of these tribal groups are on the verge of extinction as there is negative growth rate in their population.
